newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ may help NCB to boost capital - paper.
newsitem.headline: BOJ may help NCB to boost capital - paper.

text.p: The Finance Ministry and the Bank of Japan (BOJ) have begun to work out programmes to support a restructuring plan drawn up by Nippon Credit Bank Ltd (NCB), Japan's Nihon Keizai Shimbun economic daily reported in its evening edition on Thursday.
The official support is likely to focus on helping NCB boost its capital to bolster investors' confidence in NCB, the report said.

Funds already provided by the BOJ to help clean up the problem of failed mortgage firms, or "jusen", may be used to buy new NCB shares and then those new shares will be sold to financial institutions, it said. Some 80 to 90 billion yen of the funds may be used to buy the shares, it said.
Life insurers may also extend subordinated loans to NCB that could total about 150 billion yen, it also said.
The Finance Ministry and the Bank of Japan have voiced full support for NCB's restructuring plan.
